title: Cranberry Sauce
subtitle: Chunky whole-berry sauce
description: A bright, chunky whole-berry sauce of fresh cranberries simmered with orange juice, zest and sugar until the berries burst. Can be made days ahead.

ingredients.note: juiced (½ cup juice); zest one first (2 tsp zest)
1 bag, rinsed and picked over; frozen is fine

steps.heading: Make the Syrup
steps.text: Bring ½ cup water, the orange juice and the sugar to a boil in a saucepan.

steps.heading: Add the Berries
steps.text: Stir in the cranberries, orange zest and salt, and bring back to a boil.

steps.heading: Simmer
steps.text: Turn the heat to medium and let it bubble gently 10 to 12 minutes, until most of the berries have popped. Press a few against the side with the spoon if you like it a little softer; leave them for chunkier.

steps.heading: Chill
steps.text: Spoon into a bowl, cover and refrigerate until cold. It thickens as it cools.
